why.title: They can read 「가구」 but <c>not 「가」</c>
why.p1: A child who memorised whole words can only read the words they already know. Put a new one in front of them and they stop again.
why.photoAlt: A child pointing at and reading the 「가구」 card, then pausing and scratching their head at the 「가」 card
why.caption: The whole word was memorised, but a single letter inside it is brand new.
why.p2: Phonics teaches the sound each letter carries. Korean maps sound to letter almost exactly (ㄱ is g, ㅏ is a, together they make 가) — so once a child knows the sounds, they can read letters nobody taught them.

sound.d: Tap each consonant, vowel and final consonant to hear the sound it makes, then say it back. No memorising letter shapes.
sound.alt: App screen where six vowel cards are tapped in order to hear their sounds

blend.t: Then the rule for joining them
blend.d: Watch two sounds snap into one, then write it by hand. This is where reading begins.
blend.alt: App screen where ㄱ and ㅏ join into 「가」

unseen.d: Once the rule is there, a child sounds out words nobody taught them.
unseen.alt: App screen where 「교」 is picked out from among similar-looking letters

alphabet.d: One sound per letter, A to Z. Tap the picture, hear it, say it back.
alphabet.alt: App screen where Aa and an alligator holding an apple are tapped to hear the sound

blend.d: Watch a + n become an, then write it by hand. Add c and you have can.
blend.alt: App screen where a and n blend into an

read.d: String the learned sounds together to read a word, then match it to its picture.
read.alt: Picture-matching app screen where words are linked to pictures

faq.title: Try it free for a month, then decide
faq.priceLead: After the free month, <c>{{month}} KRW a month</c>
faq.priceNote: A year costs {{year}} KRW, or {{perMonth}} KRW a month · No payment details during the trial

price.a: Try it free for a month; you only pay if you carry on. It's {{month}} KRW a month, or {{year}} KRW for a year.

autoPay.q: Will I be charged automatically when the trial ends?
autoPay.a: No. There's no card on file, so nothing can be charged by itself. Whether to carry on is your call at that point.

noSignup.q: Can I look around without signing up?
noSignup.a: Yes. {{n}} storybooks are open to read right away. Signing up opens the rest, plus the reading games and the learning record.
noSignup.aBeta: Yes. We are in beta, so every storybook and every phonics unit is open. Signing up keeps a learning record for each child.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No. It opens straight in a browser — a tablet, a phone, or the TV in the living room all work as they are.

ads.a: No. Your child never sees an ad.

contract.a: No. You can stop whenever you like.

report.q: Can I see what my child has been doing?
report.a: It's all there on the parent screen. Which letters they keep stopping at, which words are worth another look — open it once at night and you can see how the day went.

twoKids.q: What if I have two children?
twoKids.a: That's fine. Each child keeps their own learning record.
